import pandas as pd

xls = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')

for name in xls.sheet_names:

import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
      'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("Archive entries:", names)

    # workbook -> sheets
    wb_xml = z.read('xl/workbook.xml').decode('utf-8')
    sheet_ids = re.findall(r'<sheet[^>]*name="([^"]*)"[^>]*r:id="([^"]*)"', wb_xml)
    rels = z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels').decode('utf-8')
    rel_map = dict(re.findall(r'Id="([^"]+)"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"', rels))
    print("Sheets:", sheet_ids)
    for name, rid in sheet_ids:
        target = rel_map[rid]
        if not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target = 'xl/' + target
        print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} ({target}) ===")
        shared = None
        if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
            ss = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
            shared = [''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')) for si in ss]
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        for row in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
            for c in row:
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}v')
                if t == 's' and v is not None:
                    val = shared[int(v.text)]
                elif t == 'inlineStr':
                    is_el = c.find('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}is')
                    val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in is_el.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
                elif v is not None:
                    val = v.text
                else:
                    val = None
                print(f"{ref}: {val!r}")

R = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}'
P = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships}'

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:

    wb_xml = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    rel_map = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}
    shared = None
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
        ss = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        shared = [''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter(M + 't')) for si in ss]
    for sh in wb_xml.iter(M + 'sheet'):
        name = sh.get('name')
        target = rel_map[sh.get(R + 'id')]
        if target.startswith('/'):
            target = target[1:]
        print(f"=== Sheet: {name} ({target}) ===")
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        for row in root.iter(M + 'row'):
            for c in row:
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find(M + 'v')
                if t == 's' and v is not None:
                    val = shared[int(v.text)]
                elif t == 'inlineStr':
                    is_el = c.find(M + 'is')
                    val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in is_el.iter(M + 't'))
                elif v is not None:
                    val = v.text
                else:
                    val = None
                print(f"{ref}: {val!r}")

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
    rows = {}
    for row in root.iter(M + 'row'):
        for c in row:
            v = c.find(M + 'v')
            if v is not None:
                rows[c.get('r')] = v.text
    total = 0.0
    per_cat = {}
    for r in range(11, 23):  # expense rows C11:C22
        cat = rows.get(f'A{r}')
        amt = float(rows.get(f'C{r}'))
        total += amt
        per_cat[cat] = per_cat.get(cat, 0.0) + amt
    print("Per category:", per_cat)
    print("Total expenses:", total)
    print("Check row A8 Total Income cell:", rows.get('B8'))
    print("Check row A23 Total Expenses cell:", rows.get('C23'))
